top_findings.title: Domain Canonical Mismatch (Apex vs WWW)
top_findings.description: Vercel edge router is set to www.bengalcampus.in as Primary with 308 redirect from apex, while codebase canonicals and sitemaps declare https://bengalcampus.in (apex).
top_findings.action: Set apex bengalcampus.in as Primary in Vercel Domains dashboard so canonicals, sitemaps, and edge routing match 100%.

top_findings.title: Homepage Title Length Slightly Exceeds 60 Characters
top_findings.description: Homepage title is 71 characters (BengalCampus | West Bengal Engineering Colleges, WBJEE Predictor & Fees). While all 20 college titles are strictly <= 56 characters, the homepage title may truncate on mobile SERPs.
top_findings.action: Shorten homepage title to <= 60 characters: 'BengalCampus | West Bengal Colleges & WBJEE Predictor' (53 chars).

top_findings.title: Meta Description Length Across College Pages
top_findings.description: Several college detail meta descriptions exceed 160 characters (180-202 chars).
top_findings.action: Trim description templates to 150-155 characters for optimal Google SERP display.

top_findings.title: Explicit Image Dimensions for Layout Shift Prevention
top_findings.description: 13 image elements on homepage cards lack explicit width and height attributes in raw HTML, which can contribute to minor Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
top_findings.action: Add explicit width/height attributes to card thumbnail containers.

quick_wins: Switch Vercel primary domain to apex bengalcampus.in to eliminate canonical mismatch in 1 click.
Trim homepage title from 71 to 53 characters.
Trim default college meta description from 202 to 152 characters.
Add explicit width/height to homepage college cards.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Robots.txt properly blocks /login, /admin, /dashboard, /api/, and /thank-you.
Sitemap.xml dynamically serves all 104 verified static pages with daily/weekly change frequencies.
Strict enterprise security headers: HSTS (63M seconds with preload), strict CSP, nosniff, DENY frame-options.
Zero redirect chains: 1 single hop 308 redirect from apex to www.

findings.title: Vercel Primary Domain vs Canonical Tag Discrepancy
findings.description: Site canonical points to https://bengalcampus.in, but Vercel edge router redirects apex to https://www.bengalcampus.in.
findings.recommendation: In Vercel Project Settings > Domains, promote bengalcampus.in to Primary Domain and redirect www to apex.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Audited institutional data: official WBJEE closing ranks across 3 rounds, WBFSC tuition fees, AICTE approval numbers.
Named expert authors (Dr. Amitava K. Roy, Prof. Soumen Mukherjee) with verified academic credentials.
In-depth content: college detail profiles average > 2,000 words each; zero thin content.
Calibrated 2026/27 timeline: accurate WBJEE 2026 examination and counselling data with no fabricated future cutoffs.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All 20 verified college detail page titles strictly <= 56 characters (35-56 chars).
Single H1 tag per page with 1.0 keyword relevance.
SSR-crawlable header navigation menus with semantic <Link> tags.
Descriptive anchor text across all internal cross-links.

findings.title: Homepage Title Exceeds 60 Characters
findings.description: Homepage title is 71 characters, which may truncate on mobile search results.
findings.recommendation: Shorten to: 'BengalCampus | West Bengal Colleges & WBJEE Predictor' (53 characters).

findings.title: Meta Description Length on Detail Pages
findings.recommendation: Tighten description string to under 160 characters.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Zero Schema.org validation errors across all 104 static pages.
Complete rich result schemas: EducationalOrganization, CollegeOrUniversity, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, WebSite.
BlogPosting schema includes Person author entity with name and jobTitle.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: 100% static site generation (SSG) with instant edge caching (x-vercel-cache: HIT / PRERENDER).
Hero background video configured with preload='none' to prioritize LCP poster image.
Modern CSS containment and responsive layout.

findings.title: Missing Dimensions on Card Images
findings.description: 13 card images lack explicit width and height attributes in raw HTML markup.
findings.recommendation: Specify width and height attributes on Image/img components to guarantee 0 CLS.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO & Agentic)
what_works: llms.txt at root passes all Lighthouse agentic criteria.
Dedicated robots.txt directives allowing GPTBot, Claude-SearchBot, and PerplexityBot.
Clean question-and-answer passage structure optimized for AI Overviews and answer engines.
No catch-all 200 responses; proper 404 status codes for agent probes.

findings.title: Optional Content-Signal Header
findings.description: No Content-Signal preference declared in HTTP headers.
findings.recommendation: Optional: declare Content-Signal in next.config.ts headers.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% of images have descriptive, non-empty alt text.
Zero broken image links across the college directory.

findings.title: Explicit Image Dimensions
findings.description: Card thumbnails should have explicit intrinsic dimensions to avoid layout shifts during lazy loading.
findings.recommendation: Set intrinsic dimensions on all thumbnail containers.

items: Switch Vercel primary production domain to apex bengalcampus.in to match codebase canonical tags.
Shorten homepage title tag to <= 60 characters.

phases.name: Phase 2: Meta & Asset Optimization (Week 1)
items: Trim college page meta descriptions to 150-155 characters.
Add explicit width/height dimensions to college card thumbnails.

phases.name: Phase 3: Topical Authority & Citations (Weeks 2-4)
items: Monitor indexation of the 3 newly published WBJEE 2026 counselling guides in Google Search Console.
Submit updated sitemap.xml to Google Search Console and IndexNow.
